tooltips.name: Optional label. Left empty = auto "YYYY-MM-DD → YYYY-MM-DD|∞".
tooltips.effectiveFrom: First calendar day (app timezone) this rate card applies to conversation-days.
tooltips.effectiveTo: Last calendar day inclusive. Leave empty for the open-ended current agreement. Creating a new open period auto-closes the previous open one the day before.
tooltips.currency: Deal currency for unit prices below (Administration → Currency). Empty = system default.
tooltips.packUnitPrice: Pack model: price per pack of N turns. Empty = platform default (1.99).
tooltips.packSize: Pack model: turns per pack. Empty = 4.
tooltips.extraBasePrice: Extra model: fixed charge once per conversation-day. Empty = 0.99.
tooltips.extraUnitPrice: Extra model: price per overage engagement. Empty = 0.49.
tooltips.extraIncludedTurns: Extra model: customer-message turns included in the base. Empty = 4.
tooltips.planIncludedUsage: Monthly free billable units from the plan (packs for pack model, conversation-day bases for extra). Matches Pricing.html plans — Lite 200 / Essential 600 / Pro 1000. 0 = pay-as-you-go (all usage billed). Apply full-month report filters so FIFO franchise consumption is correct.
